text:
maria_g: Quick heads-up — on the quant4 warmstart bring-up for magnet-3B we see a reproducible token divergence after long priming (~50k tokens). Repro command + minimal logs below, opening thread so we don't lose it.
\nmaria_g: repro:
```bash
# run in sandbox w/ int4 build
./run_eval --model magnet-3b-int4 --seed 42 --priming-file tests/long_priming/novelty.txt --max-tokens 60000 --kv-mode warmstart
``` 

maria_g: snippet from the diff (gold vs model) after ~52k tokens:
```diff
- ... the committee approved the regulation.
+ ... the committee approved the regulation?\n
```

ashok: hmm that's a punctuation flip, any pattern? always at the same token idx?

maria_g: yes, same token index relative to start of generation across 8 runs, and only when kv-mode=warmstart + quantized. FP32 baseline is stable.

kevin: can you paste args for compilation/quant flags? maybe kernel selection differs for long KV reuse.

maria_g: build flags: `QUANT=4 USE_KERNEL=auto KERNEL_HINT=rope_optimized` + runtime: `batch=1 seq_chunk=1024 cache_prefetch=on`.

liz: CI bot reported a flaky in rook harness earlier today, tagging @ci-bot for logs

ci-bot: deploy: evaluation job #11234 finished — magnet-3b-int4 on ggpu-2b (zone us-west2) logs: https://ci.internal/runs/11234 — artifacts retained 7d :memo:

ashok: can you try disabling `cache_prefetch`? my hunch: prefetch + quant packing + RoPE rescale interacts and causes a subtle KV index shift.

maria_g: running now with `cache_prefetch=off`, will post results. ETA ~12m.

kevin: if that reproduces, also try `KERNEL_HINT=rope_fallback` and `seq_chunk=2048` — different chunking changes when rotations are applied.

liz: also worth checking whether the priming text contains high-run punctuation runs or long numeric sequences — RoPE scaling sometimes drifts with long repeats.

maria_g: quick update — with prefetch=off the divergence moves from 52k -> 58k tokens (still diverges). attaching a short log excerpt:
```text
[52k] kv_idx=81901 token=...\n[58k] kv_idx=90012 token=... (mismatch detected)\n
```

maria_g: FP32 baseline: no mismatch up to 120k (ran a long-run overnight)

ashok: can you dump KV keys around the mismatched idx for int4 vs fp32? just hex of keys, might show an off-by-one or bit flip after quant packing.

maria_g: will dump. also adding a micro test that reproduces only the KV handshake (no decoder) so we can isolate kernel vs packing.

kevin: if micro test reproduces, run it with `LD_PRELOAD=valgrind` or ASAN-enabled quant memcpy to catch misaligned writes. Quant path has bespoke memcpy.

liz: please add the circuit-breaker to the test harness so rollout doesn't hit prod models with warmstart quant by default. I'll make a quick flag in the config.

maria_g: thanks. saving artifacts to /artifacts/magnet-3b/1711104321/ . Will post dumps + microtest once done.

ashok: great, ping here when dumps uploaded. if it's a packing alignment bug we can also add a unit for the quant packer to fail fast.

maria_g: uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/magnet3b/1711104321/kv_dumps.tar.gz — includes key hex, pre/post-quant arrays, and the microtest harness.

kevin: downloading, will take a look now. rough timeline: if kernel bug, fix might be small; if it's RoPE rescale/phase accumulation mismatch due to quant rounding, might need a calibrated rescale step.

maria_g: noted. filing a follow-up issue in tracker: https://jira/internal/browse/ML-5123. Thanks all :pray:
